name: Water Tower Catwalk
description: An elevated catwalk structure atop a water tower, exposed to the elements. Features rusted rails suitable for clamping equipment. The catwalk is windswept and provides a vantage point overlooking a town valley below.
scene_presence: Town below mostly dark except for high school gym and gas station canopy
Canvas tool bag swinging in gusts
narrative_significance: A remote communication outpost where Aria and Noah establish radio contact during an emergency situation. The location serves as a critical hub for coordinating disaster relief efforts, receiving distress calls from Red Creek station and communicating with June. The harsh weather conditions and isolation emphasize the urgency and danger of the crisis unfolding below.
